mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user (username, password, email, nickname, avatar, role, quota, used_space, status, is_vip, admin_bonus_quota, reward_quota) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{role}, #{quota}, #{usedSpace}, #{status}, #{isVip}, #{adminBonusQuota}, #{rewardQuota})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_user WHERE username = #{account} OR email = #{account} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_user ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET password = #{password}, nickname = #{nickname}, avatar = #{avatar}, role = #{role}, quota = #{quota}, used_space = #{usedSpace}, status = #{status}, is_vip = #{isVip}, admin_bonus_quota = #{adminBonusQuota}, reward_quota = #{rewardQuota}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_user SET used_space = GREATEST(used_space + #{delta}, 0) WHERE id = #{userId}
